title: The Goldbach exceptional set: an exponent 7/12 and conditional refinement
summary: Let \(E(X)\) count the even integers between \(4\) and \(X\) that are not sums of two primes. We combine Pintz's explicit formula for the major arcs with the exponential-sum estimate of Maynard, Pandey, and Radziwiłł to prove \(E(X)\ll_\varepsilon X^{7/12+\varepsilon}\) whenever all Dirichlet \(L\)-functions have a common fixed zero-free half-plane \(\Rea s>θ_0\), with \(θ_0<1\). The uniform \(7/8\) theorem reported in the OpenAI mathematics release supplies this input.
